task: OB-2 — route guards on GET/PUT/DELETE /api/campaigns/[id] and POST /api/campaigns/[id]/adopt
agent: general-purpose (GP-JUSTIFIED: security-relevant bounded implementation with caller analysis and red-first tests)

decision.gateFromTask: step 1 instructed: if ANY production caller does not authenticate today, do not implement; write the brief and stop
decision.summary: Every production caller of GET/PUT/DELETE /api/campaigns/[id] and POST /api/campaigns/[id]/adopt sends NO credential today. No subset of methods is safely guardable: all four verbs have an unauthenticated production caller. Adding authenticateRequest would break single-player campaign save, load, delete and legacy adoption outright.
decision.worktreeState: clean — `git status --porcelain` empty; no files created or modified under the repo tree

finding1_noTokenExistsInSinglePlayer.claim: A single-player campaign client holds no token it could attach, so 'wire the header' is not a small client change — there is nothing to wire.
evidence: src/lib/campaign/coop/coopCampaignAuthTokenStore.ts:8-12, 25-33 — the only campaign bearer token lives in sessionStorage under key `mekstation.coopCampaign.token.<matchId>`; readCoopCampaignToken returns null when matchId is null/absent.

src/pages/api/multiplayer/auth/token.ts:1-20 — minting an IPlayerToken requires an unlocked VAULT IDENTITY plus its PASSWORD ('Body: {password, displayName?, ttlMs?}'). Single-player campaign creation and play never perform that unlock.

grep over src/ for client-side `Authorization: Bearer` returns exactly 3 senders (CampaignSharePanelConnected.tsx:59, MatchBrowser.tsx:110, commitGmCombatRewind.ts:53) — all multiplayer/co-op surfaces.

finding2_guardWouldNotActuallyAuthorize.claim: Even with a token wired, `authenticateRequest` alone on these routes would be authentication without authorization — it would gate on 'holds ANY valid player token', not 'owns THIS campaign'.
evidence: src/lib/campaign/authority/campaignSessionScope.ts:22-31 — expectedScopeForCampaign returns undefined when the campaign has no coopSession.matchId, i.e. for every single-player campaign.

src/lib/multiplayer/server/auth.ts:234-246 — an UNSCOPED token is accepted unconditionally ('A token with no scope is still accepted when expectedScope was passed — transition residual'). Scope binding only fires when token.scope is present.

src/services/persistence/SQLiteService.migrations.ts:332-344 — the `campaigns` table has NO owner column (only origin_device_id); there is no stored identity a verified playerId could be compared against.

src/pages/api/campaigns/[id]/commands.ts:114-119 — commands.ts gets real authorization from a SECOND gate, isActiveCampaignSeat, which its own header comment (lines 28-33) records as refusing EVERY caller on a campaign with no co-op session (finding #29). Applying that same gate to [id].ts would refuse 100% of single-player traffic by design.

finding3_correctFixIsUpstream.claim: The stated confidentiality concern (GET at [id].ts:126-155 returns the full SerializedCampaign including contractMarket) is already owned by an in-flight spec requirement that removes the value from the wire entirely, which is the architecturally correct fix rather than a route guard.
evidence: openspec/changes/design-campaign-authority-and-sync/specs/campaign-authority/spec.md @ 41fa76989 — 'Full contract and remaining market are source-only, narrowed at the stored-envelope boundary': the full IContract and remaining ICampaignContractMarket SHALL NOT appear 'on any HTTP response'; the audience is the source instance's own server process and its persisted SerializedCampaign record.

Same spec, readback gate: 'Full private HTTP readback SHALL remain blocked until a source-only audience contract that NAMES THE READBACK AUDIENCE, its concrete caller, and its authentication story exists'. OB-2 has no named audience/caller/authentication story for the single-player persistence route, so a guard added now would not satisfy that gate either.

recommendedClientChangeIfPursued.note: UNVERIFIED estimates — no implementation was attempted; these are sizing judgements, not measured line counts.
prerequisiteDecisions: Decide what identity a single-player campaign has. Today: none. Options are (a) require a vault identity for campaign play (product decision, changes onboarding), (b) introduce a device-scoped credential distinct from the Ed25519 player token, or (c) accept that localhost single-player needs no gate and close OB-2 as not-a-defect for these verbs.

Add an owner column (or an owner field on the stored envelope) to the campaigns table — without it, a verified playerId has nothing to be checked against, and the guard authenticates without authorizing.

Decide the e2e credential story: 16 e2e call sites plus e2e/fixtures/campaign.ts and e2e/helpers/seamCampaign.ts cleanup paths would each need a token, or a test-only bypass — and a test-only bypass on an auth gate is itself a security surface.
recommendedClientChangeIfPursued.estimatedScopeIfAllPrerequisitesResolved: UNVERIFIED: ~4 client call sites + 1 token-plumbing helper + 1 SQLite migration + ~16 e2e call sites + 6 existing route test files. Well beyond the '≤15 files / ≤500 lines' cap this task carried.

nonClaims: NOT CLAIMED: that these routes are safe to leave unauthenticated in a hosted/multi-tenant deployment. The finding in the R2 P1 admission brief stands — GET returns the whole SerializedCampaign to any caller who knows the id. What is claimed is only that a route guard cannot be added today without breaking single-player play, and that the guard as scoped would not have authorized anything.

NOT CLAIMED: that the threat model was assessed. Whether MekStation's deployment surface (localhost desktop/Electron vs hosted) makes an unauthenticated campaign route a real exposure was not investigated and is the decision this brief hands back.
NOT CLAIMED: any measurement of how many e2e specs would fail. The 16 call sites were enumerated by grep; no run was performed.

NOT CLAIMED: that the source-only narrowing requirement is implemented. It is spec text on an unmerged change (design-campaign-authority-and-sync); CAMPAIGN_JOURNAL_AUTHORITY_ENABLED remains false per the same spec.
